title: Variables Deep Dive: Reassignment and Multiple Assignment
objectives: Understand variables as references to objects

content.title: Variable Reassignment
content.explanation: Variables can be reassigned to new values at any time. The old value is replaced (and garbage collected if no other references exist). This is different from mutation - reassignment changes what the variable points to.
key_points: x = 5; x = 10  # x now holds 10, not 5
Reassignment binds the name to a new object
The old object may be cleaned up automatically

content.title: Multiple Assignment
content.code:
# Assign multiple variables at once
x, y, z = 1, 2, 3
print(x, y, z)  # 1 2 3

# Swap variables
a, b = 10, 20
a, b = b, a
print(a, b)  # 20 10

# Assign same value to multiple
x = y = z = 0
content.explanation: Python evaluates the right side first, then assigns to left side. This makes swapping elegant without a temporary variable.

content.title: Tracing Variable Reassignment
content.code:
x = 5
y = x
x = 10
print(x, y)
content.explanation: y gets the value of x at that moment (5). Later changing x does not affect y because integers are immutable.

content.title: Swap Without Temp Variable
content.code:
a = 100
b = 200
# Swap a and b here
_____
print(a, b)  # Should print: 200 100

content.title: Reassignment vs Mutation
content.explanation: Reassignment changes the variable binding. Mutation changes the object itself, affecting all references.

questions.question: After: a, b = 5, 10; a, b = b, a; what is a?
What does x = y = z = 0 do?
options: Sets x to y, y to z, z to 0

content.title: Key Takeaways
points: Elegant swap: a, b = b, a

exercises.title: Variable Reassignment Practice
exercises.description: Create a variable score = 0. Reassign it to 10, then 25, then 100. Print after each change.
exercises.starter_code:
score = 0
print(score)
# Reassign and print three more times
exercises.solution:
score = 0
print(score)
score = 10
print(score)
score = 25
print(score)
score = 100
print(score)
hints: Just assign new values to the same variable name

quiz.question: After x = 5; y = x; x = 10; what is y?
quiz.explanation: y got the value 5 when assigned. Changing x later does not affect y.
